getStarted.title: Welcome, {{name}}
getStarted.intro: Three steps to start messaging your customers on WhatsApp.
getStarted.stepConnectHint: Use Meta's sign-up to link your WhatsApp Business Account.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.name: Display name
numbers.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{number}}? It stops sending and receiving, and frees a number on your plan. You can reconnect it later.
numbers.profileIntro: This is what customers see when they open your chat.
numbers.logoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB.

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp
connect.intro: You'll sign in with Facebook and choose or create your WhatsApp Business Account in a Meta window. Ecogo never sees your Facebook password.
connect.standardHint: A number not yet on WhatsApp, or one you will move off the WhatsApp app.
connect.coexistence: A number on the WhatsApp Business app
connect.coexistenceHint: Keep using the app on your phone. Ecogo imports your contacts and up to 6 months of chats.
connect.coexistenceLimits: Numbers on the Business app send at most 20 messages per second, and need WhatsApp Business app 2.24.17 or later.
connect.notConfigured: Connecting WhatsApp is not configured on this server yet.
connect.popupClosed: The Meta window closed before sign-up finished. You can try again.
connect.noCode: Meta did not finish the sign-up. Please try again.

common.comingSoonBody: This screen is part of release 1 and is being built next.

templates.title: Templates
templates.newIntro: Meta reviews every template before you can send it. Most reviews finish within minutes.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create one, or sync the ones you made in WhatsApp Manager.
templates.name: Name
templates.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, for example order_shipped.
templates.bodyHint: Use {{1}}, {{2}} … for values you fill in when sending.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} in every language? Meta will not let you reuse this name for 30 days.

send.title: Send a message
send.intro: Send a test message from a connected number. The inbox will replace this screen.
send.mode_template_hint: Works any time. Needs an approved template.
send.mode_text_hint: Only within 24 hours of the customer's last message.
send.noTemplates: No approved templates for this number yet.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.closedHint: The customer has not written in 24 hours. Only an approved template can be sent.
inbox.placeholder: Type a message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, / inserts a quick reply.
inbox.fileType: WhatsApp does not accept this file type.

developers.title: Developers
developers.intro: Connect your own systems to WhatsApp with the Ecogo API. Every request needs an API key in the Authorization header.
developers.copyNow: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
developers.usage: Send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Each key can make 60 requests per second.
developers.confirmRevoke: Revoke the key “{{name}}”? Systems using it stop working at once.
developers.noAccess: Only owners, admins and developers can manage API keys.
developers.webhooksIntro: Ecogo posts events to your HTTPS endpoint, signed with the endpoint's secret in the Ecogo-Signature header. Failed deliveries are retried for about 24 hours.
developers.secretNow: Copy this signing secret now. It will not be shown again.
developers.confirmDelete: Delete the endpoint {{url}}? It stops receiving events at once.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.languageHint: For templates, for example en, hi or ta.
contacts.optedInNow: This customer agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from us
contacts.evidenceHint: For example: signed up at the shop counter
contacts.fileHint: Needs a header row with a phone column. Name, language, tags (separated by ;) and opt_in (yes or no) are recognised; other columns become fields.
contacts.countryCode: Country code for numbers without one
contacts.confirmConsent: Everyone marked opt_in = yes agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from us
contacts.importResult: {{rows}} rows: {{created}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} skipped. {{opted_in}} opt-ins and {{opted_out}} opt-outs recorded.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. A campaign sends an approved template to the contacts with the tags you pick.
campaigns.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can see and send campaigns.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.limitHint: Messaging limit {{tier}}: sending pauses when the number reaches it and resumes as the 24-hour window frees up.
campaigns.noNumber: Connect a WhatsApp number first, from Numbers.
campaigns.noTemplates: This number's account has no approved templates. Create one under Templates.
campaigns.variablesHint: Type text, or insert a contact field. Add a fallback after | for contacts without the field, for example {{contact.first_name|there}}; contacts with an empty field and no fallback are skipped.
campaigns.noTags: No tags yet. Tag contacts on the Contacts screen first.
campaigns.audienceCounts: {{eligible}} of {{total}} will get it. Skipped: {{opted_out}} opted out, {{blocked}} blocked, {{no_opt_in}} with no opt-in record.
campaigns.confirmCancel: Cancel this campaign? Messages already sent are not recalled.
campaigns.notExpanded: Recipients are listed once the campaign starts.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can see analytics.
analytics.unpriced_one: {{count}} billable message went to a country without a rate here, so it is not in the estimate.
analytics.unpriced_other: {{count}} billable messages went to countries without a rate here, so they are not in the estimate.
analytics.note: Days are in {{tz}}. Delivered is a share of sent and read a share of delivered. Charges are an estimate from Meta's rate card for billable messages; Meta bills you directly.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rolesHelp: Owners manage everything, including billing. Admins manage the team, numbers, templates and campaigns. Agents answer chats in the inbox. Developers manage API keys and webhooks.
settings.inviteSent: Invite emailed to {{email}}. You can also share this link; it works for 7 days.
settings.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from this workspace? They lose access right away.
settings.timeZoneHint: Analytics days and campaign schedules follow this time zone.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change these.
settings.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Your other sessions are logged out.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were logged out.
settings.twoStepOff: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, asked for every time you log in.
settings.twoStepOn: On. Logging in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
settings.twoStepScan: Add this key to your authenticator app, or open the link on your phone, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.twoStepDisableHint: Enter a current code to turn it off.
settings.twoStepAdmin: Platform admins must keep it on.
settings.retentionHint: Older messages and their media files are deleted every day and cannot be recovered. Reports keep their totals.

invite.title: Join {{tenant}}
invite.loginFirst: You already have an account with {{email}}. Log in to accept.
invite.otherAccount: This invite is for {{email}}, but you are logged in as {{current}}. Log out, then open the link again.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.useOther: Log out and use another account

admin.title: Admin console
admin.needs2fa: Turn on two-step verification before using the admin console.
admin.deliveries24: Webhook deliveries to the customer, last 24 hours
admin.suspendReason: Reason for suspending (kept in the audit log)
admin.reactivateReason: Reason for reactivating (kept in the audit log)
admin.conversationsHelp: Message content is hidden. Reading a conversation needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
admin.viewReason: Why do you need to read this conversation? (support ticket or case)
admin.noWebhooks: No webhooks from Meta in this window.
admin.invoiceTruncated: Showing the newest 500; narrow the dates to see the rest.
admin.plansHelp: Prices are in rupees per month. A plan is offered to customers once it is shown and has its Razorpay plan ID: create a monthly plan with the same amount in the Razorpay dashboard and paste its ID here.
admin.seatRazorpayPlan: Razorpay plan ID for one extra seat (optional)
admin.badPrice: Enter prices in rupees, for example 2999.
admin.deletionsIntro: Requests Meta sends when someone removes the app in Facebook. Delete anything held for the person, then mark the request done; they can follow it on a public status page.

billing.trial_one: Your trial ends tomorrow ({{date}}). Choose a plan to keep sending.
billing.trial_other: {{count}} days left in your trial, until {{date}}.
billing.endsOn: Ends on {{date}}. Sending stops after that.
billing.pastDue: Your last payment failed. Razorpay will retry; sending stops on {{date}} if it is not paid.
billing.ended: Your plan has ended, so messages and campaigns cannot be sent. Choose a plan below.
billing.chosenDuringTrial: You chose {{plan}}. The first charge is on {{date}}, when the trial ends.
billing.paymentPending: Waiting for Razorpay to confirm your payment. This page updates once it does.
billing.usage: Using {{numbers}} of {{includedNumbers}} numbers and {{seats}} of {{includedSeats}} seats.
billing.confirmCancel: Cancel your plan? It stays active until {{date}} and is not charged again.
billing.confirmDropPlan: Stop the plan you chose? Your trial continues and nothing is charged.
billing.paymentsOff: Online payment is not switched on yet. Contact Ecogo support to subscribe.
billing.noPlans: Plans are not published yet. Contact Ecogo support.
billing.detailsLead: These appear on your GST invoices. Add your GSTIN to claim input tax credit.
billing.detailsSaved: Billing details saved. They apply to invoices issued from now on.
billing.noInvoices: Invoices appear here after each payment.
billing.invoicingOff: GST invoices are not switched on yet.
billing.extraSeatsLead: {{included}} seats are included. Extra seats cost {{price}} each per month + GST. You have {{members}} members.
billing.extraSeatsScheduled: Done. Fewer seats take effect from your next billing date.
billing.extraSeatsDone: Done. New seats appear once Razorpay confirms the charge.
billing.changeScheduled: Done. The new plan starts with your next billing cycle.
billing.metaFees: WhatsApp message fees are charged by Meta to the payment method in your Meta Business account, not by Ecogo.
billing.bannerEnded: Your Ecogo plan has ended and sending is paused.
billing.bannerTrial_one: Your free trial ends within a day.
billing.bannerTrial_other: Your free trial ends in {{count}} days.
